{"id":1867295617,"question_id":4147,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"6 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1766901142,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1867295617/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Cost to Acquire Required Items","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n    long long minimumCost(int cost1, int cost2, int costBoth, int need1, int need2) {\n        if(need1 == 0 and need2 == 0) return 0;\n\n        ll min_cost = min<ll>({cost1 , cost2 , costBoth});\n        if(min_cost == costBoth) return costBoth * max<ll>(need1 , need2);\n\n        ll total = LLONG_MAX;\n\n        ll op1 = 0 , op2 = 0 , op3 = 0;\n        \n        op1 = ((cost1 * need1) + (cost2 * need2));\n\n        op2 = ((costBoth * need1) + (cost2 * need2));\n    \n        op3 = ((cost1 * need1) + (costBoth * need2));\n    \n        total = min<ll>({total , op1 , op2 , op3});\n    \n        return total;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-cost-to-acquire-required-items","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1416}
